# system.startLatencyTest

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Launch the Latency test on one channel - for testing purposes only.

```lua
system.startLatencyTest(channel, value, maxDuration)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `channel` | integer | yes |  |
| `value` | number | yes |  |
| `maxDuration` | number, maximum is 100ms | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
system.startLatencyTest(0, 100, 50) -- set CH1 value to +100% during 50ms and observe the delay with Trainer input (Bluetooth / S.Port / External module)
```
